description: Grav: a flat-file CMS with a web admin, Markdown pages, themes and plugins, with the first admin created at install and the site content on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Yopass: share secrets through one-time links; the browser encrypts with OpenPGP and the server keeps only ciphertext in Memcached (bundled) or Redis until it expires or is read. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
